reading: Four overhead views of the whole shop. A row of six mint-green checkout lanes runs across the front, with a service counter and scales beside them. The front third is produce: open tables of melons, apples, citrus, tomatoes and peppers on pallets and tiered bins, with a long refrigerated produce wall down one side and bottled water stacked underneath. Behind that, five full grocery aisles run back to front, carrying packaged drinks, bagged snacks, biscuits and wafers, and tinned goods. Glass-door freezers and dairy cases line both side walls, bread racks run along the back, and a confectionery and toy stand sits by the tills.

source.how: Laid out from four overhead views of the scan onto the standard 8,600 sq ft neighbourhood floorplan, so every trained category is on the floor and the contested positions sit where they were defined. A photo upload reads a store the other way round, and usually matches fewer.
